reusable-field-tool.prompt: Confirm that the current fictional use is legal for this exact field or camp tool.
canonicalFacts: This is an interpretive field or camp tool; no effect is inferred from its name or prose.
The exact source must remain in current Trainer custody through acceptance.
settlementFacts: Retain the exact reusable source row.
Apply no automatic sheet, map, inventory-output, or campaign-clock value beyond the durable decision receipt.
reusable-field-tool.presentationDescription: Request bounded GM adjudication for this reusable field or camp tool. The exact source is retained.

consumable-crafting-material.prompt: Confirm one legal current use of this exact crafting or care material.
canonicalFacts: Recipes, outputs, and prerequisites remain bounded GM adjudication; they are never inferred from canonical prose.
Acceptance settles only the reviewed source disposition and durable decision receipt.
settlementFacts: Consume one exact reserved source unit.
Grant no unselected output or hidden character mutation.
consumable-crafting-material.presentationDescription: Reserve one exact unit and request bounded GM adjudication for its crafting or care use.

reusable-crafting-tool.prompt: Confirm current legal use of this exact reusable crafting or care tool.
canonicalFacts: Recipe, feature, Edge, configuration, and output eligibility are bounded GM adjudication.
The runtime never parses item prose or invents a crafted output.
settlementFacts: Retain the exact reusable source row.
Grant no unselected output or hidden character mutation.
reusable-crafting-tool.presentationDescription: Request bounded GM adjudication for this reusable crafting or care tool.

consumable-combat-tool.prompt: Confirm one legal current use of this exact interpretive combat item.
canonicalFacts: Targeting, placement, checks, and battlefield consequences require bounded GM adjudication.
No target, hazard, condition, Move, or modifier is inferred from the item name or prose.
settlementFacts: Record one bounded GM-approved use and its Standard Action boundary.
Consume one exact reserved source unit.
Apply no unselected target or battlefield mutation.
consumable-combat-tool.presentationDescription: Reserve one exact unit and request bounded GM adjudication before this interpretive combat use settles.

reusable-combat-tool.prompt: Confirm one legal current use of this exact reusable interpretive combat item.
canonicalFacts: Configuration, usage limits, targets, range, and consequences require bounded GM adjudication.
No condition or area effect is inferred from the item name or prose.
settlementFacts: Record one bounded GM-approved use and its Standard Action boundary.
Retain the exact reusable source row.
Apply no unselected target or battlefield mutation.
reusable-combat-tool.presentationDescription: Request bounded GM adjudication before this reusable interpretive combat use settles.
